## Checklist (see CONTRIBUTING.md; unchecked items must be explained)
- [ ] Evidential and adoption weight are shown separately for every claim I touched
- [ ] Every claim states what would change its weight
- [ ] Refutations name their target and rest on material or primary-text evidence (Rule 9)
- [ ] Nothing was erased: revisions and corrections are new log entries
- [ ] IDs are new or unchanged, never reused or renumbered
- [ ] Computed results are filed as `synthetic` and stay `proposed` until outside review

### If this adds or changes a test
- [ ] The test was written down in the log before any data was collected
- [ ] Positive control included and passed (or the failure is published)
- [ ] Held-out calibration, leaving out the whole source work
- [ ] Genre control and attractor control included
- [ ] Decision thresholds were set from calibration, not guessed
- [ ] Code, corpus list with source IDs, fixed seeds and raw outputs are in the run-files folder
- [ ] The page says plainly what the result does not show
